We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have guidance: steps enumerated forward: TBS protection, HWE, DIBAL-H reduction, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari reaction. But we need retrosynthetic steps (reverse). So we need to break down target into precursors via 5 reactions, likely corresponding to those forward steps reversed.

Thus retrosynthesis: target (protected?) includes TBS? The SMILES shows O[C@H]1... there is no TBS group; maybe the target is deprotected final product? Actually the target includes free OH groups (O attached). The forward steps: start from some simpler molecule, protect with TBS, then HWE to form double bond, DIBAL-H reduction, TMSOTf protection, Still-Gennari to get final product? Not sure.

We need to propose route with 5 reactions. Use templates from catalog. We have found a template (id 29646) that matches target and corresponds to deprotection of TBS? The retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]' meaning forward: protect alcohol with TBS (tert-butyl dimethyl silyl). So retro step: remove TBS to get alcohol. So first retrosynthetic step: target -> remove TBS to give TBS-protected precursor? Wait target has OH, so retro step would add TBS to give protected intermediate. So step 1: target -> protected alcohol (TBS ether). So we need to apply template 29646 in reverse (i.e., forward is protection, retro is deprotection). So we can use apply_template with target and template 29646 to get precursor (protected). Let's do that.
